description: GGUF header, chat template and capability reads from synthetic files. Input `hex` is the file bytes, or null for a missing file. Expected: `buffer` is parseGgufBuffer on the bytes, `header` is parseGgufHeader on the file (first 64 KiB only), `chatTemplate` is readChatTemplate, `capabilities` is capabilitiesFromTemplate of that template. Whole numbers are decimal strings, so 64-bit values stay exact. A null header means the reference returned null. Malformed input must not panic or over-allocate.
